[[File:Battlestar Galactica CCG logo.png|thumb|Original Battlestar Galactica CCG game logo.]]
The '''Battlestar Galactica Collectible Card Game''' follows the Colonial fleet as it faces political challenges and Cylon threats. [[TCGMix]] offers a browser playtest.<ref name="catalog" />

== History ==

WizKids published the game.<ref name="bsgrules" /> The original set appeared in May 2006 and the ''Betrayal'' expansion followed in November. WizKids halted development of the planned ''Martial Law'' expansion in March 2007.<ref name="bsghistory" /> The complete rulebook credits Jim Long for the original concept and Matt Robinson, [[Chuck Kallenbach]] and Tyler Bielman for game design. Kallenbach was also the lead developer.<ref name="bsgrules" />

== Gameplay ==

Players recruit personnel and deploy ships, competing for control of the Colonial fleet through influence.<ref name="bsgrules" />

== Online play ==

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/bsg/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-battlestar-galactica-ccg">[https://tcgmix.com/bsg/ Play Battlestar Galactica CCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194152/https://tcgmix.com/bsg/ Internet Archive].</ref>
